disgorge.definition:
v cause or allow (a solid substance) to flow or run out or over
v eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth

vt. 吐出, 流注, 被迫交出
vi. 呕吐

n. The act of disgorging; a vomiting; that which is

disgorger.translation: （香槟酒）去酒泥机, 吐渣机

disgorgers.translation: (disgorger 的复数)  （香槟酒）去酒泥机, 吐渣机

disgorging.definition:
v cause or allow (a solid substance) to flow or run out or over

disgorging.translation: 被迫交出, 吐出(赃物)

n. 耻辱, 不名誉
vt. 使受耻辱, 使失体面

n. The process of separation, or the condition of being

disgruntle.definition: v. put into a bad mood or into bad humour
